correctness.rationale: For each non-all-L period-n symbolic word, the Jacobian is a signed monomial matrix; right visit count t determines coordinate permutation. For t not a multiple of three the single three-cycle forces all eigenvalue moduli 2^{n/3}; for t=3q, diagonal exponents are q+c_0,q+c_1,q+c_2 for nonnegative left-block counts. For n>=4, the minimum normalized modulus 2^{1/n} occurs exactly when t=3 and a cyclic left-gap is zero. Marking a right visit counts n/3[C(n-1,2)-C(n-4,2)]=n(n-3) words; any nontrivial repeated word with three R would have all three positive equal gaps and fail the condition. Hence n-3 primitive n-cycles. Independent enumeration of 3-R words for n=4,...,12 confirms counts 4,10,18,28,40,54,70,88,108; all-n conclusion rests on proof, not finite data.
